question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it . If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

Participants in our studies reviewed these online dating profiles.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4' **i.e.** "No error."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence *"Participants in our studies reviewed these online dating profiles" *is grammatically correct and does not contain any errors.
 
• Here's why each segment is correct:
 
 
• **"Online dating profiles"** - This segment is correct. It serves as the object of the sentence, indicating what was reviewed by the participants.
 
• **"Participants in our" **- This segment is also correct. It begins the subject of the sentence ("Participants in our studies"), indicating who performed the action of reviewing.
 
• **"Studies reviewed these"** - This segment is correct. It completes the subject ("Participants in our studies") and begins the verb and object ("reviewed these online dating profiles"), indicating the action that was performed and what it was performed on.
 
 

Therefore, the** correct sentence **is: *'Participants in our studies reviewed these online dating profiles.'*
